title: Inkwell Academy deployment diagram
description: How Inkwell Academy runs: one Cloudflare Worker with static assets and no database. The browser runs the whole game.

nodes.name: Player's browser
nodes.description: Runs the Godot web export (WebGL 2) and keeps the best score.

nodes.name: Cloudflare edge
nodes.description: Runs the Worker on icelander.net/games/retro/inkwell-academy*, ahead of the games hub's less specific route icelander.net/games/*.

nodes.name: inkwell-academy Worker
nodes.description: worker/index.ts: the signed-in game page and the joined engine file; every other path is a static asset from ./dist.

nodes.name: icelander.net login service
nodes.description: accounts.icelander.net, in the icelander.net repository (accounts/): who holds the site_session cookie and their games: roles. Reached only through a service binding.

artifacts.name: Godot web export
artifacts.description: index.html, index.js, index.pck and the engine split into index.wasm.0, .1 (each under 25 MiB), built by build.mjs.

artifacts.name: Loader, styles and headers
artifacts.description: boot.js, shell.css, favicon.svg and _headers (a strict Content-Security-Policy), copied into dist/.

artifacts.name: Worker script
artifacts.description: The fetch handler, bundled by wrangler.

relationships.description: HTTPS: the page, the engine and the game's files.
Service binding ACCOUNTS (entrypoint Internal): the page needs a signed-in player.
